_meta.conventions: Namespace pattern: pages.<route>.<element>, components.<feature>.<element>, common.<element>, errors.<context>. Keys camelCase, values native English. Pluralization uses ICU MessageFormat: {count, plural, one {item} other {items}}.

notFound.title: 404 — Not found
notFound.description: This page does not exist. Maybe you meant:

home.eyebrow: A travel guide for you and a friend
home.title: Let's plan a trip to Kazakhstan.
home.intro: This is a decision tool — browse destinations on the map, compare ready-made routes, and save favourites to your shortlist. Share the current view with a friend via a link.
home.pathMapDescription: Interactive map + filters. Click destinations and add them to your shortlist.
home.pathRoutesDescription: 3 different templates: 5, 7, and 10-day versions. A good starting point.

map.title: Map
map.tipTooltip: Click a pin or list row to zoom in.

rentalPin.subtitle: Rental car pickup and return in Aktau.

sights.title: Sights
sights.subtitle: <bold>{count}</bold> destinations. Use filters to narrow down options.
sights.emptyDescBoth: Try removing filters or changing your search term.
sights.emptyDescQuery: Check the spelling or try a different search term.
sights.emptyDescFilters: Try removing category or region filters.

routes.title: Ready-made route templates
routes.intro: Three different starting points: one for nature, one for cities, and one longer road trip. Pick a template and customise it into your own route.

routeDetail.useAsTemplateTitle: Use as a template for your own itinerary
routeDetail.useAsTemplateBody: Copy the preset.days from this file with id {id} and bring them into the userItinerary array in src/data/itinerary.ts. Then customise freely.

itinerary.title: My itinerary
itinerary.intro: This is your own route template. Empty at first — fill in the days as the trip locks in, or copy a template from the <routes>ready-made routes</routes>.

shortlist.title: Shortlist
shortlist.intro: {count} destinations. Choose region by region what you'll visit — get a ready-made route in Google Maps, Yandex, or 2GIS.
shortlist.shareText: Here's my shortlist for Kazakhstan — what do you think?
shortlist.clearDialogDescription: All {count} destinations will be removed from the list — including favourites and visited markers. You can undo for a moment via the notification.
shortlist.emptyDescription: Add destinations to the list from the Sights page. You can promote top picks to favourites ★, mark visited ones ✓ during the trip, and build region-by-region routes in Google Maps, Yandex, or 2GIS.
shortlist.usageHint: Tick the destinations you're visiting today — then press Open route and choose a navigator (Google Maps, Yandex, 2GIS, or Apple Maps). The route opens ready-ordered, with your current location as the starting point.
shortlist.overLimitWarning: Navigators support at most {max} points per route — remove selections to continue.
shortlist.aktauWarning: Note: Mangystau desert routes are not fully on Google Maps. The route link shows the direction, but also use an offline map (e.g. Maps.me) and a local driver.

today.metaDescription: Today's plan, anchors, emergency card, and quick links during the trip.
today.title: Today
today.intro: The day's plan, anchors, cash, and emergency card — at a glance.

budget.title: Budget
budget.intro: Estimates per region and category. Prices per person unless otherwise noted. Mangystau prices assume 2–4 people in the car.

info.title: Practical info
info.intro: Visa, pre-departure checklist, transport, language, and safety.
info.safetyHeading: Safety — what it means in practice

carRental.pickupDates: Arrive here on {pickup} and return on {return}.
carRental.navigatorHint: Open Google Maps, 2GIS, Yandex, or Apple Maps — route from your current location to this point.
carRental.officeDescription: Address per the company's 2GIS listing. Don't go here — the car is picked up and returned at ЖК Оазис above.

offline.title: Download for offline
offline.description: Save the whole trip to your phone before you go — every sight, photo and the map work with no signal.
offline.unsupported: Offline download needs the app installed (add to home screen) or the production build.
offline.statusStale: Saved earlier — download again to refresh
offline.includesNote: Includes all {sights} sights, photos and routes in the current language
offline.keepBrowsing: You can keep using the app — the download continues in the background.
offline.unavailableToast: Offline download needs the installed app
offline.mapTip: For turn-by-turn navigation offline, pair with a dedicated maps app like Organic Maps — the Navigate button already links out to it.

footer.disclaimer: Always check practical info before departure — visas, rates, and connections can change.

commandPalette.title: Command palette
commandPalette.description: Search for sights and navigate between pages

offlineBanner.message: Offline mode — showing saved content. The map and images may be limited.

shortlistUrlSync.droppedUnknownToast: Dropped {count} unknown destinations from the shared link
shortlistUrlSync.saveFailedDescription: The browser's storage is full or blocked. The list stays for this session but may disappear on refresh.
shortlistUrlSync.dialogDescription: The link contains {urlCount} destinations. You already have {localCount} of your own destinations on the list.
shortlistUrlSync.unknownDroppedNote: {count} unknown destinations were dropped from the link — they may have been removed or the IDs have changed.
shortlistUrlSync.explanation: Merge adds the new destinations from the link to your list — you don't lose your own. Replace yours keeps only the link's contents and removes {localOnlyCount} of your own.
